svg.text: 0.9 m CLEAR · BUNDED FLOOR · OWN FLUE
VOID OVER THE HALF-LANDING · 1.1 m GUARDS
FFL 1677.50 · C10 corrected: every floor stands on something
Grid north up · thin brown lines = natural ground contours every 1 m (survey TIN) · red = parcel boundary, dashed = 1 m setback
Front door on the west façade under a canopy,
straight into the entrance hall; the hall ends
on the lit core lobby, the stair behind a
glazed safety screen, and the roof terrace
Groceries: garage → fire door → core lobby →
lift is a 4.4 m walk, all indoors (rule 5.1).
The 1.2 m unloading aisle along the east side
Two 3.35 m shutters lined up with the two car
lanes; reverse in, drive out. LC300 in bay 2.
A 4.1 m workbench along the back wall, bikes
hung above it. The whole garage stands on the
walls of the service room below.
WC + shower sits over the main-floor entry and
drains west to the road by gravity. Plant room
cylinder, MVHR) with a 1.2 m door; water tanks
Office 3.2 × 3.5 m on the roof terrace, walls
on the grid lines u 9.4 / 12.6 and v 13.0.
